name: pidev
description: pi is a self-extensible AI coding agent harness. The base install is lean; functionality is added via packages (web UI, knowledge base, chat integrations) installed at runtime with 'pi install'. Exposed via ttyd for browser-based terminal access.

notes.text: Access pi in your browser at http://<container-ip>. The first run launches the setup wizard.
Config and session data is stored in ~/.pi/.
Browser access uses ttyd, which has no authentication by default. Restrict port 80 with a reverse proxy or firewall before exposing it publicly.
